name: Afro Pop Community Dance Classes - Noosa Shire Council
description: Find your rhythm, get fit and have fun with these African inspired dance classes. Improve memory, coordination and movement to upbeat recorded music. Learn West African moves and discover rhythm. These classes are for everyone. Discover the joy of dance with the community every Saturday in Noosa. \\n \\nThis 4 week course presented by the Noosa Shire Council is FREE. The classes are progressive and it is recommended that you commit to the full 4 weeks to gain the maximum benefits. \\n \\nParticipants will need to bring water wear comfortable clothes.
